_note: Compiled 2026-10-05 from public sources; every value cites the page it came from; null = no public evidence found (not proof of absence). fiu_ind_registered: Lok Sabha Unstarred Q.5805 (30 Mar 2026), Annexure-I (54 VDA SPs as on 09.03.2026). on_sahyog: Delhi HC order 29 Apr 2025 in W.P.(CRL) 1563/2024 recording I4C's status report (33 VDASPs onboarded), media reports, or the VASP's own announcement. Verify with FIU-IND / I4C before operational use. Nodal contacts are not public and stay placeholders.

vasps.name: Binance
vasps.notes: Country detail: Seychelles (FIU-registered entity: Nest Services Limited, earlier Binance International Limited); no official global HQ. Annexure-I #47 'Nest Services Limited (Earlier Binance International Limited) | Binance | Seychelles'. FIU-IND show-cause 28 Dec 2023 (PIB 1991372); FIU penalty Rs 18.82 crore, Order 10/DIR/FIU-IND/2024 dated 19.06.2024 (https://fiuindia.gov.in/pdfs/judgements/Binance_Order_10_2024.pdf). Sahyog: HT 4 Jun 2025 says 'Efforts are underway to bring major global players like Binance and Bitget onto the system'; no later confirmation found, so null. Binance LE page: 'For global law enforcement agencies, please use the following link: https://app.kodexglobal.com/binance/signup'.

vasps.name: KuCoin
vasps.notes: Country detail: Seychelles (FIU-registered entity: Peken Global Limited). Annexure-I #41 'Peken Global Limited | KuCoin | Seychelles'. FIU penalty Rs 34.5 lakh, Order 08/DIR/FIU-IND/2024 dated 22.03.2024 (https://fiuindia.gov.in/pdfs/judgements/PGL_Order_08_2024.pdf). Sahyog per HT 4 Jun 2025 (officials): 'international platforms like KuCoin and Bybit have also been onboarded' - media report, not an official list. KuCoin page (updated 07/30/2025): 'Please submit all law enforcement requests via the KuCoin Information Request System'.

vasps.name: Bybit
vasps.notes: Country detail: UAE (Dubai HQ per Wikipedia); FIU-registered entity Bybit Fintech Limited, Seychelles. Annexure-I #48 'Bybit Fintech Limited | Bybit | Seychelles'. FIU penalty Rs 9.27 crore, order dated 31 Jan 2025 (https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2098153). HQ: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bybit. Sahyog per HT 4 Jun 2025 (media). No official LE request page found; https://www.bybit.com/en/help-center/article/How-to-Report-Stolen-Assets only says Bybit 'will cooperate with law enforcement requests from competent authorities'. Beware look-alike site bybitexcai.com (lists a non-Bybit email).

vasps.name: Bitget
vasps.notes: Country detail: Seychelles (registered Dec 2022; previously Singapore). Not in Lok Sabha Q5805 Annexure-I (54 registered VDA SPs as on 09.03.2026); listed in Annexure-II (apps/URLs directed for takedown). Bitget press release 23 Jun 2025: 'Bitget has officially onboarded onto India's Sahyog portal'. So: on Sahyog but not FIU-registered. LE guide (dated 9 Jun 2025, read via r.jina.ai proxy) also gives lawenforcement@bitget.com; signups must use an official agency email.

vasps.name: Coinbase
vasps.notes: Country detail: USA (San Francisco per Wikipedia); FIU-registered entity Coinbase India Private Limited. Annexure-I #49 'Coinbase India Private Limited | Coinbase | India (Linked to Global Coinbase)'. Coinbase: 'Criminal subpoenas and official requests for criminal matters should be submitted here' (Kodex); other LE questions to subpoenas@coinbase.com. No Sahyog report found.

vasps.name: Kraken

vasps.name: MEXC
vasps.notes: Country detail: Seychelles (MEXC Global); related entities in Singapore and USA (Denver). Not in Lok Sabha Q5805 Annexure-I (54 registered VDA SPs as on 09.03.2026); listed in Annexure-II (apps/URLs directed for takedown). (listed as 'MEXC Global'). MEXC announcement: 'As part of our registration process with the Financial Intelligence Unit-India (FIU-IND), MEXC will temporarily suspend services for users in India starting February 28, 2026' (https://www.mexc.com/announcements/article/temporary-suspension-of-services-for-existing-users-in-india-17827791532970); registration may have progressed after 09.03.2026 - re-check. LE channel is MEXC's 'Law Enforcement Online Request System (LEORS)'; access approval generally takes 15-20 business days. Pages read via r.jina.ai proxy.

vasps.name: CoinDCX
vasps.notes: Country detail: India (Mumbai). Annexure-I #1 'Neblio Technologies Private Limited | Coin DCX'. Sahyog list #1 (spelt 'Nebilo Technologies'). vasps.name: WazirX
vasps.notes: Country detail: India (operator Zanmai Labs Pvt Ltd); parent Zettai Pte Ltd, Singapore. Annexure-I #8 'Zanmai Labs PVT LTD | WazirX'. Sahyog list #8; also HT 4 Jun 2025: 'Among the domestic exchanges, WazirX has been confirmed to be onboarded'.
